import subprocess
import psutil
import time
import os
def task_func(script_path: str, timeout=10) -> dict:
    if not os.path.isfile(script_path):
        raise OSError("Script path does not exist")
    proc = subprocess.Popen(['bash', script_path])
    p = psutil.Process(proc.pid)
    start_time = time.time()
    total_cpu_time = 0.0
    total_mem_inc = 0
    prev_times = p.cpu_times()
    prev_rss = p.memory_info().rss
    while True:
        time.sleep(0.1)
        try:
            cur_times = p.cpu_times()
            cur_rss = p.memory_info().rss
            delta_cpu = (cur_times.user + cur_times.system) - (prev_times.user + prev_times.system)
            total_cpu_time += delta_cpu
            delta_rss = cur_rss - prev_rss
            if delta_rss > 0:
                total_mem_inc += delta_rss
            prev_times = cur_times
            prev_rss = cur_rss
            if not p.is_running():
                break
            if time.time() - start_time >= timeout:
                p.terminate()
                p.wait()
                break
        except (psutil.NoSuchProcess, psutil.ZombieProcess):
            break
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    cpu_usage = (total_cpu_time / elapsed * 100) if elapsed > 0 else 0.0
    return {'CPU Usage': cpu_usage, 'Memory Usage': total_mem_inc}
